text: Completed source-preserving line bidi slice. BidiLine/BidiCodepoint and NativeUnicode.resolveLine expose actual paragraph base levels, L1-adjusted source levels, explicit X9 omissions and L2 global codepoint maps through bounded pointer-only ABI in the existing isolated Rust library. All 91707 BidiCharacterTest records pass exact levels and source order; focused wrapped/context/supplementary/ownership/range cases and existing 22143 segmentation records pass. testJVM, testNative, probeUnicode/test (12) and textNative/test (7) passed with no ignored tests. VISION, plans and docs updated; evidence docs/evidence/graphics/2026-10-27-bidi-lines.md. Shared paragraph/fallback/shaping/L3/L4/editing geometry, separate BidiTest coverage and full P0.8/platform/host gates remain open.
